configure_decisions.WAIT_USE_POLL: WasmFS epoll syscalls return ENOSYS in the pinned SDK; W12 supplies blocking waits around the selected readiness interface.
configure_decisions.disable-rpath: The Linux configure template supplies portable C declarations; ELF runtime-linker flags do not apply to Wasm.
configure_decisions.cross-run-fallbacks: No target programs are executed by configure. Preserve upstream cross answers in the report; runtime assumptions require kernel validation.
configure_decisions.posix-fadvise: The pinned Emscripten implementation is advisory-only and has no writeback effect. Do not enable PostgreSQL pre-sync directory walks for that no-op; retain the real fsync pass and durability barriers.
